_meta.spec_ref: Kairos Production Specification v3.0 — Master Response Pack
_meta.description: Source-grounded, permission-aware intent-response knowledge base for Kairos. No URLs appear in responses except the ZoikoTime contact page which is pinned only in agent escalation and help intents. search_redirects map keywords to in-app navigation routes for the frontend router.

escalation_policy.description: When the user cannot resolve their issue through Kairos responses, suggest connecting to a live human agent. Offer to send an email directly to the user manager. Manager email is sourced from the onboarding registration form — never ask mid-conversation. If manager has the same unresolved issue, escalate to zoikogroup@gmail.com.

email_routing_logic.step_1: Employee submits issue → Kairos tries to resolve from knowledge base
email_routing_logic.step_2: If unresolved → suggest live agent OR offer to email manager
email_routing_logic.step_3: Manager email is pre-filled from onboarding form
email_routing_logic.step_4: If manager also cannot resolve → escalate to zoikogroup@gmail.com
email_routing_logic.note: Never ask the employee to manually re-enter their manager email mid-chat. Always pre-load from registration form.

invariants.I1: Every factual product claim must be grounded in approved knowledge — no guessing.
invariants.I2: Kairos must never help with hidden, covert or non-transparent workforce monitoring.
invariants.I3: Kairos must never provide legal, HR disciplinary, medical, tax or financial advice.
invariants.I4: Human escalation must always be visible — never blocked or hidden.
invariants.I5: Kairos must never fabricate features, certifications, pricing or roadmap items.
invariants.I6: Responses must respect the user's role, workspace and data permission boundary.
invariants.I7: All interactions must be logged with sources and context for audit.
invariants.I8: Kairos must reinforce that employees can always see what is recorded about them and use correction/dispute routes.

intents.response:
Hi there! 👋 I'm Kairos, your ZoikoTime assistant.

I'm here to help you understand the app, your work data, leave, pay, privacy settings, Zoiko Connect, account settings and technical issues.

What can I help you with today?

keywords: what's the purpose of this app
intents.response:
ZoikoTime is an AI-powered workforce intelligence platform — not a surveillance tool.

It helps organisations understand:

✅ Meaningful work time — how time, tools and outcomes align
✅ Work authenticity — confidence scores for each work session
✅ Productivity intelligence — activity, focus and workload signals
✅ Policy compliance — governed, transparent and role-based
✅ Audit-ready records — exportable logs and evidence packs

As an employee, ZoikoTime gives you full visibility into what is recorded about you and why — with correction and dispute routes always available.

keywords: difference between active time and work hours

intents.response:
📊 Active Time vs Total Work Hours

Total Work Hours — Total time from clock-in to clock-out including breaks
Active Time — Time you were actively using your device: keyboard, mouse, apps
Break Time — Time you were officially on a recorded break
Idle Time % — Percentage of work time where no activity was detected
Productive Apps % — Percentage of time spent in work-classified applications

Example: If you worked 1h 17m and Active Time is also 1h 17m, your Idle Time is 0% — meaning you were active throughout your entire session.

keywords: i was working but it shows idle
intents.response:
💤 Idle Time — What It Means

Idle Time is recorded when no keyboard, mouse or application activity is detected for a set period.

Common reasons you may see Idle Time:
- You stepped away from your desk without taking a formal break
- You were on a phone or video call without touching the screen
- Your screen locked or the device went to sleep
- You were reading a document without scrolling or clicking

What to do:
If the idle time was legitimate work such as a meeting or a call, you can submit a Time Correction via My Timesheet.

Important: Idle time is not automatically treated as non-work. It is a signal reviewed in context by your manager according to your organisation's policy.
suggestions: How do I correct my time?

intents.response:
🛡️ Work Authenticity — Proof-of-Work Confidence

Every work session receives a Work Authenticity Score from 0 to 100%.

How it's calculated:
- 📸 Screenshot integrity (if screenshots are enabled)
- ⌨️ Keyboard and mouse activity patterns
- 🖥️ Device verification signals
- 🔍 Tamper detection checks

What the statuses mean:
✅ Validated — Session passed all checks with high confidence
⚠️ Warning — Minor signals detected, reviewed in context
🚨 Flagged — Session failed one or more integrity checks
⏳ Pending — Session is still being processed

A flagged session does not mean punishment. It means the system flagged something for human review. All decisions are made by authorised people — not an automated system.

View all your sessions under My Data → What's Recorded.
suggestions: How do I dispute a flagged session?
What is recorded in my sessions?

keywords: why do i have a flag
intents.response:
🚨 Why Was My Session Flagged?

A flagged session does not automatically mean wrongdoing. Common reasons:

- Very low keyboard or mouse activity during a long session
- Screenshot data was missing or incomplete (if screenshots are enabled)
- Unusual activity pattern compared to your baseline
- Device verification signal was not received

What happens next:
1. A human reviewer — your manager or HR — reviews the session
2. No automated disciplinary action is taken by Kairos
3. You will be informed if action is required by your organisation

You can dispute it:
Go to My Data → What's Recorded → select the session → Raise a Dispute

Kairos cannot change session scores or remove flags — that requires human review.

📝 Raising a Dispute or Correction Request

For session disputes:
1. Go to My Data → What's Recorded
2. Find the session in question
3. Click Raise a Dispute
4. Describe the issue and submit

For time corrections (missed clock-in or clock-out):
1. Go to Time & Attendance → My Timesheet
2. Select the date
3. Click Request Correction, enter your reason and submit

What happens after:
- Your manager or HR is notified
- They review and approve or decline your request
- You receive a notification on the outcome

Kairos cannot approve or modify your records. All correction decisions are made by authorised humans in your organisation.

📸 Screenshots — What You Need to Know

Are screenshots taken?
Screenshots are only taken if your organisation has enabled this feature. Not all workspaces use screenshots.

- They are taken at intervals set by your organisation's policy
- Only authorised roles such as manager, HR and admin can review them

keywords: what does zoikotime know about me
intents.response:
🔒 What ZoikoTime Records About You

ZoikoTime is built on a transparency-first principle — you always know what is recorded.

What may be recorded depending on your org's policy:

⏱️ Work Time — Clock-in, clock-out, active time, break time, idle time
📱 App Activity — Apps used and time spent, Productive, Neutral or Restricted
📸 Screenshots — Periodic screenshots only if your org has enabled this
🖥️ Device Signals — Device type, session continuity, verification checks
🔐 Access History — Who accessed your data, when and why

What is NOT recorded:
- Personal apps or websites excluded by policy
- Content you type — keylogging is not used
- Audio or video of you personally
- Any data outside your defined work sessions

Your rights:
- View your own data: My Data → What's Recorded
- See who accessed your data: My Data → Access History
- Manage preferences: My Data → Privacy Settings
- Raise corrections or disputes at any time

How do I change my Privacy Settings?

keywords: does it track what i type
intents.response:
🔐 What ZoikoTime Does NOT Record

ZoikoTime does not use keylogging and does not record the content you type. It does not record personal audio or video of you.

Screenshots may only be taken if enabled by your organisation and are shown transparently within the app — you can always view your own screenshots.

ZoikoTime tracks app activity (which apps are open and for how long) — not what you write, say or see in those apps.

🔍 Access History

Found under My Data → Access History in the left sidebar.

What it shows:
- Every time an authorised person such as manager, HR or admin viewed or exported your data
- Timestamp of each access
- Reason logged for the access

ZoikoTime maintains immutable access logs — they cannot be deleted or altered. This protects you as an employee and ensures full accountability from anyone who views your records.

If you see an access you don't recognise or understand, raise a query with your manager or HR team.

Submit a request through My Data → Privacy Settings where available, or contact HR admin or ZoikoTime support for formal handling of your request.

Some settings are controlled by your organisation, including tracking rules, screenshot policy, app categories, retention periods and access permissions.

intents.response:
🌙 Dark / Light Mode

You can switch between dark and light themes using the moon or sun icon in the top-right corner of the app header.

Alternatively go to Account → Settings to set your preferred theme permanently.

🌐 Language & Locale

You can change the app language using the language selector shown as US English by default in the top-right corner of the app header.

For workspace-level locale changes, contact your admin.

🖥️ System Permissions

ZoikoTime may require system permissions such as Screen Recording and Accessibility, depending on your organisation's enabled features.

If a permission prompt appears:
1. Follow the system instructions to grant the required permission
2. Restart ZoikoTime after granting permission

If permissions are managed by your company IT policy, contact your IT admin for assistance.

🔄 Sync & Connectivity

ZoikoTime needs an internet connection to sync session data. If your connection drops, the app may temporarily show delayed updates.

What to do:
1. Reconnect to the internet
2. Keep the app open and allow it to sync automatically
3. If records still appear missing after syncing, check My Timesheet or contact support

💻 Device Changes

If you use a new or different work device, ZoikoTime may require sign-in, verification and system permissions again. Device signals may also be reviewed under your organisation's policy.

If the new device is company-managed, contact your IT team if installation or permissions are blocked.

🧩 Uninstalling or Removing ZoikoTime

If ZoikoTime is installed by your organisation, you may not be able to remove or disable it yourself. Contact your manager, IT admin or HR team for guidance.

Kairos cannot help bypass organisation controls or disable transparent tracking during assigned work sessions.

🔧 App Not Tracking — Troubleshooting

Step 1 — Check your status
- Look at the top of your Today screen — does it show Working in green?
- Check the floating badge in the bottom-right corner — is the timer running?

Step 2 — Make sure you're clocked in
- If there's no active session you may need to clock in

Step 3 — Restart the app
- Close and reopen the ZoikoTime desktop app fully
- Ensure the app has the necessary system permissions such as screen recording and accessibility

Step 4 — Check your internet connection
- ZoikoTime requires an active connection to sync your session data

Step 5 — Still not working?
Contact the ZoikoTime support team or say "Email my manager" and I'll prepare a message on your behalf.

🔐 Login Issues

Forgot your password?
- On the login screen click Forgot Password
- Enter your registered work email
- Follow the reset link sent to your inbox

Account locked?
- After multiple failed login attempts your account may be temporarily locked
- Wait 15 minutes and try again, or contact your admin

Still can't log in?
Contact ZoikoTime support or your organisation's IT or HR team as they may manage account access.

🛠️ App Performance Issues

Quick fixes to try:
1. Restart the app — close it fully and reopen
2. Check for updates — make sure you're on the latest version
3. Restart your computer — clears memory and background processes
4. Check system resources — ensure your device isn't overloaded with other heavy applications

If the problem persists, contact ZoikoTime support with your operating system version, ZoikoTime app version and a description of when the issue happens.

🚪 Signing Out

1. Scroll to the bottom of the left sidebar
2. Click Sign Out

Important: Make sure you Clock Out before signing out so your work session is properly recorded. If you sign out without clocking out, your session may be flagged as incomplete.

🚫 I can't help with that.
